name: provenflow
description: Design and verify state machines with nuXmv, and review code: model-check a code base or pull request, with verified fixes.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @provenflow/language && npm run build -w @provenflow/extract && npm run build -w @provenflow/server && npm run build -w @provenflow/app
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @provenflow/language && concurrently -n server,app -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @provenflow/server" "npm start -w @provenflow/app"
scripts.test: npm test -w @provenflow/language && npm test -w @provenflow/extract && npm test -w @provenflow/server && npm test -w @provenflow/app -- --watch=false
